detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A newly staged dynamic frontal wide shot establishes the university lawn path and the three-character blocking derived from <Picture 1>. S2 walks on screen left, S1 walks in the center, and S3 walks on screen right, all moving slowly toward the camera with natural height differences. S1 looks visibly sleepy and starts raising her right hand toward her mouth. The camera cuts on the rising hand movement.

[Shot 2] At 00:00.250, action-match cut to a close-up of S1. Her sleepy eyes narrow and close as her right palm covers her mouth. She performs one brief natural yawn: her shoulders rise gently with the inhalation, her mouth opens behind her hand, and her long two-tone hair sways subtly with her steps. She finishes the yawn, lowers her hand slowly, and retains a drowsy expression. Her soft yawn is clearly audible.

[Shot 3] At 00:01.250, cut along the same screen axis to a medium close-up of S3 walking barefoot on the right side of the path. She tilts her face up toward screen left to look at S1, smiles with bright mischievous eyes, and lets her fluffy white tail swing lightly. In a crisp, cheerful childlike voice, with precise Chinese lip synchronization, S3 says: <d>[Chinese] 伊芙姐姐大白天睡懒觉，真是个大懒虫。</d> She finishes with a pleased smile while maintaining her gaze toward S1.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.650, cut to a close-up of S2 on screen left. She walks with both hands behind her back, raises her chin, arches one eyebrow, and looks up toward screen right at S1. Her twin ponytails and dark tail bounce gently with each step. In a proud teasing voice, with precise Chinese lip synchronization, S2 says: <d>[Chinese] 就是，太阳都晒屁股啦！</d> Her dark tail lifts once as she ends with a smug grin.

[Shot 5] At 00:04.650, cut to a frontal medium three-shot. S1 abruptly stops in the center. S2 and S3 each take one additional half-step from their existing momentum, then stop and turn toward her. S1 slowly inhales, half-closes her eyes, and looks between both girls with tired, restrained exasperation. Her arms hang loosely beside her body as she says in a sleepy, slightly husky voice: <d>[Chinese] 两个死小鬼，好好的周末不让我睡个懒觉。</d> She stresses the final words, and her expression becomes calmly intimidating.

[Shot 6] At 00:07.200, S1 swiftly lifts her right arm and extends her index finger toward S2 on screen left. Cut along the direction of the pointing arm to a medium close-up of S2, with S1’s extended finger remaining visible in the right foreground and clearly aimed at S2. S1 asks from just outside the frame: <d>[Chinese] 你小黑子作业写完了吗？</d> As soon as S2 hears “作业,” her smug smile disappears. Her upright cat ears gradually fold outward and droop, her shoulders sink, and her hands move from behind her back to the front of her skirt. She nervously pinches the fabric, blinks quickly, lowers her gaze toward the ground, and lets her previously raised dark tail fall behind her.

[Shot 7] At 00:08.650, cut back to a close-up of S1. She retracts her pointing hand, turns her head toward S3 on screen right, and lets her gaze travel visibly from S3’s face down toward her feet. S1 begins the next reprimand: <d>[Chinese] 还有你，小白……</d>

[Shot 8] At 00:09.050, eyeline-match cut to a brief close-up of S3’s bare feet on the pale gray stone path. Both feet make clear physical contact with the ground and cast soft contact shadows. While S1 continues off screen, <d>[Chinese] 你怎么又不穿鞋子……</d> S3 curls her toes inward once, slides her right foot backward, and begins hiding it behind her left foot.

[Shot 9] At 00:09.600, cut to a medium close-up of S3’s face and upper body. S1 finishes from off screen: <d>[Chinese] ……到处乱晃？</d> S3’s cheerful smile gradually freezes. She first looks down toward her feet, then slowly raises her eyes to peek at S1. Her white cat ears angle outward and lower, her shoulders contract, both hands move behind her back, and her torso curls inward slightly. Her fluffy white tail stops swinging and slowly drops. She presses her lips together and holds an innocent caught-in-the-act expression.

[Shot 10] At 00:11.250, cut to a slightly wider frontal three-shot and hold through 00:12.500. S1 stands in the center, closes her eyes, releases one resigned sigh, lowers her arm, and shakes her head once before turning forward and resuming her walk. On screen left, S2 keeps her ears drooped, looks down, and continues pinching the front of her skirt. On screen right, S3 keeps one bare foot hidden behind the other, then takes two small tiptoe steps to follow S1. S2 and S3 exchange one brief guilty glance and hurry after her, ending on a playful awkward afterbeat.

overall_soundscape:
Native stereo campus ambience with a gentle breeze moving through leaves, distant birds, subtle outdoor room tone, and restrained background activity. The opening footsteps remain spatially distinct: S1’s fluffy slippers sound soft and muted in the center, S2’s platform shoes produce light firm taps on the left, and S3’s bare feet create soft skin-on-stone contacts on the right. All three sets of footsteps stop in sync with the momentum stagger in Shot 5. Include S1’s quiet yawn near the beginning and her resigned sigh at the end. Each character has a stable voice: S1 is sleepy, slightly husky, mature, and increasingly rapid during her scolding; S2 is proud and playfully sharp before becoming silent and guilty; S3 is bright, innocent, and mischievous before becoming embarrassed. Only the active speaker moves her lips in each dialogue section. S1’s dialogue remains clearly audible while she speaks just outside the frame during the reaction and foot insert shots.

non_diegetic_music:
Very light playful pizzicato strings and soft woodwinds at low volume beneath the dialogue. Add one subtle descending plucked accent when S2’s ears droop, a second tiny comedic accent when S3 curls and hides her bare foot, and a restrained final accent under S1’s sigh and the girls’ guilty glance.
